finding_text: GitHub says this vulnerability affected github.com, multiple GitHub Enterprise Cloud variants, and GitHub Enterprise Server.

A single crafted git push could achieve arbitrary server-side command execution because unsanitized push option values were inserted into internal metadata in a way that let attacker-controlled input become trusted downstream fields.
GitHub says it reproduced the issue within 40 minutes, identified the root cause on March 4, 2026, and deployed a fix to github.com later that same day.

GitHub says the exploit path was bounded by an anomalous server code path not used in normal github.com operations, and its logs linked observed use of that path only to Wiz testing rather than to customer-data access or other user activity.
